name: InvestFlow
tagline: Next-Gen HYIP Investment & Asset Management Platform
description: A financial investment and asset management web platform designed for investment programs, financial tracking, multi-tier referrals, automated interest distribution, and compliance workflows.

user_portal: Portfolio dashboard with balances, deposits, withdrawals, active investments, and referral earnings
Interactive growth charts and recent activity ledger
Investment plans with fixed or flexible durations and configurable interest schedules
Crowd investment pools with funding progress, investor counts, and deadlines
Interest accrual tracking and investment history
Deposits through automated gateways or manual transfers with receipt uploads
Withdrawal requests with payout addresses, fee calculation, and status tracking
Transaction statements for deposits, withdrawals, plan purchases, earnings, and bonuses
Multi-level referrals, personalized referral links, tracking, and commission logs
Two-factor authentication with QR enrollment and backup recovery codes
KYC document submission and approval status
admin_portal: Dashboard monitoring users, KYC verification, deposits, withdrawals, platform net worth, and active investments
Financial reports with CSV export and print options
User directory and bulk account operations
VIP rankings based on cumulative investment volumes
Investment plan and crowd pool management
Branding, currency, registration, deposit, withdrawal, and pool settings
SMTP email and SMS API configuration
Tawk.to, Google Analytics, reCAPTCHA, and Facebook Comments integrations
Multi-admin role-based access control and audit logs
automation: Investment expiration and optional principal return
Monthly and annual referral milestone processing
Execution audit logs in the cron_logs table

cryptocurrency: Direct crypto wallets: BTC, USDT, ETH, TRX
manual_custom: QR code uploads with transaction ID and receipt verification

security_architecture: PDO prepared statements for critical queries
Session timeout and user-agent consistency checks
Privilege separation between admin and user contexts
File upload MIME-type validation, extension allowlisting, and unique file hashing

steps: Create a MySQL database and database user
Update database credentials in config/database.php and includes/database.php
Set write permissions on required upload directories
